earnings.title: D.R. HORTON, INC., AMERICA’S BUILDER, REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL 2026 EARNINGS AND INCREASES QUARTERLY DIVIDEND TO $0.50 PER SHARE
highlights: Home sales revenues of $8.4 billion on 22,915 homes closed
Home sales revenues of $30.6 billion on 84,202 homes closed
Repurchased 24.0 million shares of common stock for $3.6 billion, reducing outstanding share count by 8%, and paid cash dividends of $513.3 million
